notes.title: Introducing Grand Casino Simulator – Watch the Announcement Trailer!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re super excited to finally share what we’ve been working on — say hello to Grand Casino Simulator!
This is our next big project after Operation: Polygon Storm, and it’s something completely different (but just as chaotic in all the right ways).

:movie_camera: Watch the Announcement Trailer now:
[previewyoutube=tAgSJ150_zE;full][/previewyoutube]

In Grand Casino Simulator, you’ll build and run your own casino — solo or in co-op with friends. Place machines, serve guests, manage staff, run pawn shops, unlock new areas, and keep the whole thing from falling apart when things get... weird.

This isn’t just about profits — it’s about surviving the madness of running a casino that never sleeps.

:sparkles: What to expect:
Online co-op for 1–4 players

Fully customizable casino layout

NPCs with unpredictable behavior

Hilarious tools (like the trusty fire extinguisher)

High-end visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5

A lot of surprises we’re not ready to spoil (yet)

Want to be part of it early?
Wishlist the game now to support us and stay in the loop

[b]Sign up for the playtest directly on the Steam page — we’ll be inviting players later this year![/b]

Thanks for being here from the start — we’ve got a lot more to show you soon.
Let us know what you think of the trailer, and feel free to hop into our Discord to chat!

notes.title: RELEASE UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 
It's been a long time since last update, but we've decided to take time and make a major update for a Release from Early Access. We received a lot of feedback and suggestions about our game. In this update we took into account a part of the wishes. This update contains tons of new content: maps, weapons, throwing weapons,  hats. We have added additional languages to game. Besides new content we also made  a small rebalance of the game, a lot of new kicked objects, more death zones on some maps, new mechanics and etc.

Changes list:

New maps:

- Military Base
- Subway
- Ship Wreck


- Table with players was added, Now you can check how many rounds you won by pressing TAB button.
- Spectator mode. Now you can watch opponents and there Knockouts :D
- 9 new languages: Chinese, Polish, German, Dutch, French, Turkish, Italian, Spanish, Russian
- Knock on surface with angle was replaced with movement penalty. 
- 6 new weapons.
- 4 new throwing weapons.
- 8 new hats.

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheToxicStudio
Join discord and discuss our game: https://discord.gg/m378EXb

notes.title: Update 0.5: Island rework, more knockouts, fixes
notes.notes:
Hi all, "and another one" update 0.5 here. More knockouts, island rework, fixes.

Changes list:
- Island map was reworked.
- Weapons attack, weapon throw and throwable goods knockouts now pushing the enemy.
- Now you can push knocked characters with your leg kicks.
- Character now have 1 sec immune after previous knock.
- Added button sounds to the main menu.
- Added hit marker.
- In-game alerts should no longer overlap.
- Physical materials was added to all objects on the map (Object should more "Alive" now with bounces, friction etc.).
- Loading label was added to create server and disconnect actions.
- Fixed wrong map rotation behaviour on Island.
- Character should no more stand still after he died.
- Server list now cleans once you change region.
- Some fixes to face change logic.
- "No face and hat" bug was fixed.

Join discord and discuss our game: https://discord.gg/m378EXb

notes.title: Update 0.4: Battle mechanics changes, fixes
notes.notes:
Hello dear players. We uploaded another weekly patch to Steam. This patch contains battle mechanics changes, fixes, new weapon.

Detailed changes list: 
- Added new weapon to rotation - Fish.
- Object kick aiming was improved.
- Weapon attack now uses vertical camera rotation for aiming.
- Hand attack animation was improved. Should look more accurate and smooth now.
- Reworked "Wake up" mechanics to decrease teleportation effect. 
- Character speed in air was decreased.
- Added particle effect on knocked character. (Not working when you using self-knock)
- Knocked characters now receives much less damage. (Because now you can hit knocked character with weapon. Self-knocked character still receive full damage)
- Throwed weapon hit now trigger's hit sound too.
- Hit sound volume was increased.
- Added killing triggers to spikes on Coliseum which placed on the wall in the center.
- Fixed colliders on Island map.
- Disconnected player should no longer break match logic.
- Character no longer rotates after you close pause menu.
- Now you can pick up weapon from dead player.
- Fixed animation stuck after leg kick in the air.
- Main menu scene optimization.

Join discord and discuss our game: https://discord.gg/m378EXb

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 - Game balance, death zones, fixes.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We received a lot of feedback and suggestions about our game. In this update we took into account a part of the wishes. This update contains: a small rebalance of the game, a lot of new kicked objects, more death zones on some maps, and of course fixes.

Changes list:
- Limit of the wins on map was decreased from 5 to 3.
- All throwable stuff now have same throw force. As for now you can expect almost the same throwing behaviour for all throwables.
- Weapon attack animation speed was increased by 25%.
- Leg kick animation speed was increased by 25%.
- Leg kick damage was decreased from 6 to 3 damage.
- Knockout time for all weapons was decreased from 5 to 3 seconds.
- Changed objects kick aim algorithm. Objects kicks now should be more predictable.

- Construction map changes: 
Cement death zone size was increased by ~50%.
Beams count was decreased from 12 to 8( minus 2 for each bundle ).
Map size was decreased.
Increased amount of "physics" objects.

- Coliseum map changes:
Central hole size was increased by ~50%.
Bis spikes which places around center now kills the player.
Columns with swords now kills the player.

- Storehouse map changes:
Increased amount of "physics" objects.
You can no longer reach top shelf.

Island map changes:
Increased amount of "physics" objects.
New obstacles.

- Tickrate of the game was increased from 25hz to 50hz.
- Controls panel was added into in-match pause menu.
- Fixed cursor lock when you kicked in menu after disconnect.
- Knock sound no longer trigger on self knock ( fake death ).
- Added hit sound. Trigger when you deal damage to the enemy.

Join discord and discuss our game: https://discord.gg/m378EXb

notes.title: Small update 2
notes.notes:
Hello again. Here is second patch with small fixes and some changes to mechanics.

List of changes: 

- Punching power of self knockout (play dead feature) was increased by 35%.
- Character ragdoll friction decreased by 25%.
- Colliseum minor map changes.
- Fixed different holes in the colliders on the island.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Here is first patch with some fixes :)

Fixes list: 
- Fixed weapon duplication.
- When host disconnect all players will be kicked to the main menu.
- Fixed bug with music player. ( Sometimes the music player stopped )
- Fixed boxes position on Roof.
- Fixed hole in colliders on Island.

notes.title: Release date UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Good afternoon, dear community, we have a number of important announcements for you.[/b][/h1]

With great regret, we are forced to report that the release is delayed for another 1 month. Our team still consists of only 2 people and we do not want to repeat eBall mistakes. The delays are caused by the fact that the concept of the game and many mechanics have undergone cardinal changes many times (to make you understand initially we wanted to make a single player game). 

The game will be released initially in early access. We plan to regularly fill the game with new content: maps, weapons, new game mechanics. Early access will help us better prepare for a full release. The development process will be adjusted taking into account the wishes of our players.

We also want to implement a bot system during early access. This will allow players to enjoy the game even when they are palying alone
